notes:
# Blackline 0.15.137

* Lines of a conversation sit closer together: every message carried 3 px above and below it, which put a gap between two lines from the same person that Discord does not have.
* The emoji suggestions are just the suggestions — no heading above them.
* A mention never shows somebody's address, only the name (and the name they go by elsewhere, when it differs).
* Notes on a profile take more than one line.
* Everything you type into reads at the size of the chat.
* On a one-line message the tick or clock sits on that line; on a longer one it stays in the corner.
* Clicking a call tile expands it on its own again: the rail beside a pinned tile laid the stage out in two columns in the expanded dock and the call looked broken. It comes back when it lays out properly.
* The ring around somebody speaking is back to its old weight.
